column3: NKJV includes “from God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “standing before God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “standing before the throne.”
NKJV lacks the repeated “the lake of fire” at the end of the verse, following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “This is the second death, the lake of fire.”
